title: A part of an assembled item (D565, D566)
description: One file a part, assets/data/parts/<part>.json: its type (types.json), and either its model with its points, mass and bounds, or, for a part made by code, its numbers. Checked by tools/items/part.ts; read by the assembler (terra_items::assembly).

part.description: The file's name without .json: the recipe's part id.

type.description: Its part type, a key of types.json's types.

kinds.description: The kinds it is made for, when its type fits more than one (a haft is an axe's or a spear's): its size is checked for those.

model.description: The model under the asset root, made to its type's frame (D566).

centre_m.description: Its centre of mass in its frame.

bounds_m.description: Its least and greatest corner in its frame, written by the part checker.

cover_m.description: A trim's span along the line, from its frame's origin: [below, above].

up.description: A full point's roll (a seat or a nock, D566).

size.description: m: a diameter, or [width, thickness] for a flat tang.
